data.text: I lift my eyes to the mountains. Where does my help come from?
data.titulo: My Help Comes from the LORD

data.text: My help comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
May he not let your foot slip; may the one who watches over you not slumber.
data.titulo: The LORD Watches over Your Steps

data.text: Indeed, the one who watches over Israel neither slumbers nor sleeps.
The LORD watches over you; the LORD is your shade at your right hand.
The sun will not strike you by day, nor the moon by night.
The LORD will keep you from all evil; he will keep your life.
The LORD will keep your going out and your coming in, from now on and forever.
